hero.title: A record of work, not test tricks.
hero.sub: A planned direction for recording verified learning, teaching sessions, and physical projects. Described plainly without crypto or blockchain claims.
hero.strip: In active conceptual design · Tied to the four-step loop

plannedNotice.title: Planned Direction · Not Active Today
plannedNotice.notice: The Passport is a planned direction in development. It is not an active credential or software system today. In Chamba today, evaluation happens through human-evaluated daily practice tests and baseline diagnostics.
plannedNotice.liveCallout: View the live learning tracks on Floor G

theLoop.label: THE RECORD
theLoop.title: Four proof points for every learner.
theLoop.lead: Conventional certificates record seat time or multiple-choice test scores. The Passport is planned to record four tangible kinds of evidence.

stages.name: Learn It
stages.summary: Concepts solved without assistance on unfamiliar questions, evaluated by human guides.

stages.name: Teach It
stages.summary: Logged hours teaching junior peers and proving deep mastery through explanation.

stages.name: Build It
stages.summary: Physical models, working programs, or measured experimental setups constructed by hand.

stages.name: Show It
stages.summary: Public presentations, live defenses, and exhibitions answering unscripted questions.

plainExplanation.label: PLAIN MONOGRAPH
plainExplanation.title: Why we reject crypto and hype.
plainExplanation.lead: We do not believe certificates require blockchains, tokens, or digital buzzwords. True credibility comes from clear evidence: what problem you solved, who evaluated it, and whether you can defend it in person.

points.title: Human Examination
points.detail: Every record is signed by an identified guide or fellow who sat with the student during the unassisted evaluation.

points.title: Transparent Artifacts
points.detail: Anyone reviewing a learner's passport can see the actual problem statement, the student's handwritten work, and the code or physical model built.

points.title: Permanence Without Waste
points.detail: A simple public monograph web page and printed portfolio sheet provide all the permanence a future employer or university needs.
